Ba-barakat hai woh Khuda jis ne apne bande par Furqaan naazil kiya hai taake woh saare aalameen ke liye azaab-e-Ilaahi se daraane waala ban jaaye

Aasmaan o zameen ka saara mulk usi ke liye hai, aur us ne na koi farzand banaaya hai aur na koi us ke mulk mein shareek hai. Us ne har shai ko khalq kiya hai aur saheeh andaaze ke mutaabiq durust banaaya hai

Aur un logon ne Khuda ko chhod kar aise khuda bana liye hain jo kisi bhi shai ke khaaliq nahin hain balke khud hi makhlooq hain, aur khud apne waaste bhi kisi nuqsaan ya nafa ke maalik nahin hain, aur na un ke ikhtiyaar mein maut o hayaat ya hashr o nashr hi hai

Aur yeh kuffaar kehte hain ke yeh Quran sirf ek jhooth hai jise unhon ne gadh liya hai aur ek doosri qaum ne is kaam mein un ki madad ki hai, haalaanke un logon ne khud hi bada zulm aur fareb kiya hai
Aur yeh log kehte hain ke yeh to sirf agle logon ke afsaane hain jinhein unhon ne likhwa liya hai aur wahi subah o shaam un ke saamne padhe jaate hain
Aap keh dijiye ke is Quran ko us ne naazil kiya hai jo aasmaanon aur zameen ke raazon se baakhabar hai, aur yaqeenan woh bada bakhshne waala aur meharbaan hai

Aur yeh log kehte hain ke is rasool ko kya ho gaya hai ke yeh khaana bhi khaata hai aur baazaaron mein chakkar bhi lagaata hai, aur is ke paas koi farishta kyon nahin naazil kiya jaata jo is ke saath mil kar azaab-e-Ilaahi se daraane waala saabit ho
Ya is ki taraf koi khazaana hi gira diya jaata, ya is ke paas koi baagh hi hota jis se khaata peeta. Aur phir yeh zaalim kehte hain ke tum log to ek jaadoo-zada aadmi ka ittibaa' kar rahe ho
Dekho un logon ne tumhaare liye kaisi kaisi misaalein bayaan ki hain, yeh to bilkul gumraah ho gaye hain aur ab raasta nahin pa sakte hain
Ba-barakat hai woh zaat jo agar chaahe to tumhaare liye is se behtar saamaan faraaham kar de, aisi jannatein jin ke neeche nahrein jaari hon, aur phir tumhaare liye bade bade mahal bhi bana de
Haqeeqat yeh hai ke un logon ne qiyaamat ka inkaar kiya hai, aur hum ne qiyaamat ka inkaar karne waalon ke liye Jahannam muhayya kar diya hai
Jab aatish-e-Jahannam un logon ko door se dekhegi to yeh log us ke josh o kharosh ki aawaazein sunenge
Aur jab inhein zanjeeron mein jakad kar kisi tang jagah mein daal diya jaaega to wahaan maut ki duhaai denge
Us waqt un se kaha jaaega ke ek maut ko na pukaaro balke bahut si mauton ko aawaaz do
Paighambar! Aap un se poochhiye ke yeh azaab zyaada behtar hai ya woh hameshgi ki Jannat jis ka saahibaan-e-taqwa se waada kiya gaya hai, aur wahi un ki jaza bhi hai aur un ka thikaana bhi
Un ke liye wahaan har khwaahish ka saamaan maujood hai, aur woh us mein hamesha rehne waale hain, aur yeh Parwardigar ke zimme ek laazmi waada hai

Aur jis din bhi Khuda un ko aur un ke khudaaon ko jinhein yeh Khuda ko chhod kar pukaara karte the sab ko ek manzil par jama karega aur poochhega ke tum ne mere bandon ko gumraah kiya tha ya yeh az-khud bhatak gaye the

To yeh sab kahenge ke tu paak aur be-niyaaz hai, aur humein kya haq hai ke tere ilaawa kisi aur ko apna sarparast banaayein. Asl baat yeh hai ke tu ne inhein aur un ke buzurgon ko izzat-e-duniya ata kar di to yeh teri yaad se ghaafil ho gaye, is liye ke yeh halaak hone waale log hi the

Dekha tum logon ne ke tumhein woh bhi jhutla rahe hain jinhein tum ne khuda banaaya tha. To ab na tum azaab ko taal sakte ho aur na apni madad kar sakte ho, aur jo bhi tum mein se zulm karega use hum bade sakht azaab ka maza chakhaayenge

Aur hum ne aap se pehle bhi jin rasoolon ko bheja hai woh bhi khaana khaaya karte the aur baazaaron mein chalte the, aur hum ne ba'z afraad ko ba'z ke liye wajh-e-aazmaaish bana diya hai. To musalmaano! Kya tum sabr kar sakoge, jab ke tumhaara Parwardigar bahut badi baseerat rakhne waala hai

Aur jo log hamaari mulaaqaat ki umeed nahin rakhte woh kehte hain ke aakhir hum par farishte kyon nahin naazil hote, ya hum Khuda ko kyon nahin dekhte? Dar-haqeeqat yeh log apni jagah par bahut maghroor ho gaye hain aur intehaai darje ki sarkashi kar rahe hain
Jis din yeh malaaika ko dekhenge us din mujrimeen ke liye koi bashaarat na hogi, aur farishte kahenge ke tum log door ho jaao
Phir hum un ke aamaal ki taraf tawajjoh karenge aur sab ko udte hue khaak ke zarron ke maanind bana denge
Us din sirf Jannat waale honge jin ke liye behtareen thikaana hoga aur behtareen aaraam karne ki jagah hogi
Aur jis din aasmaan baadalon ki wajah se phat jaaega aur malaaika jauq dar jauq naazil kiye jaayenge
Us din dar-haqeeqat hukoomat Parwardigar ke haath mein hogi, aur woh din kaafiron ke liye bada sakht din hoga
Us din zaalim apne haathon ko kaatega aur kahega ke kaash main ne Rasool ke saath hi raasta ikhtiyaar kiya hota
Haaye afsos! Kaash main ne falaan shakhs ko apna dost na banaaya hota
Us ne to zikr ke aane ke baad mujhe gumraah kar diya, aur Shaitaan to insaan ka ruswa karne waala hai hi
Aur us din Rasool aawaaz dega ke Parwardigar! Is meri qaum ne is Quran ko bhi nazar-andaaz kar diya hai
Aur isi tarah hum ne har nabi ke liye mujrimeen mein se kuch dushman qaraar de diye hain, aur hidaayat aur imdaad ke liye tumhaara Parwardigar bahut kaafi hai

Aur yeh kaafir yeh bhi kehte hain ke aakhir in par yeh Quran ek dafa kul ka kul kyon nahin naazil ho gaya? Hum isi tarah tadreejan naazil karte hain taake tumhaare dil ko mutma'in kar sakein, aur hum ne ise thehar thehar kar naazil kiya hai
Aur yeh log koi bhi misaal na laayenge magar yeh ke hum us ke jawaab mein haq aur behtareen bayaan le aayenge
Woh log jo Jahannam ki taraf munh ke bal kheench kar laaye jaayenge un ka thikaana badtareen hai aur woh bahut zyaada behke hue hain
Aur hum ne Moosa ko kitaab ata ki aur un ke saath un ke bhai Haaroon ko un ka wazeer bana diya
Phir hum ne kaha ke ab tum dono us qaum ki taraf jaao jis ne hamaari aayaton ki takzeeb ki hai, aur hum ne inhein tabaah o barbaad kar diya hai

Aur qaum-e-Nooh ko bhi, jab unhon ne rasoolon ko jhutlaaya to hum ne inhein bhi gharq kar diya aur logon ke liye ek nishaani bana diya, aur hum ne zaalimeen ke liye bada dardnaak azaab muhayya kar rakha hai
Aur Aad o Samood aur Ashaab-ur-Rass aur un ke darmiyaan bahut si naslon aur qaumon ko bhi tabaah kar diya hai
Aur un sab ke liye hum ne misaalein bayaan keen aur sab ko hum ne neest o naabood kar diya
Aur yeh log us basti ki taraf aaye jis par hum ne pattharon ki bauchhaar ki thi, to kya un logon ne use nahin dekha? Haqeeqat yeh hai ke yeh log qiyaamat ki umeed hi nahin rakhte
Aur jab aap ko dekhte hain to sirf mazaaq banaana chaahte hain ke kya yahi woh hai jise Khuda ne rasool bana kar bheja hai

Qareeb tha ke yeh humein hamaare khudaaon se munharif kar de agar hum log un khudaaon par sabr na kar lete. Aur anqareeb un logon ko maaloom ho jaaega jab yeh azaab ko dekhenge ke zyaada behka hua kaun hai
Kya aap ne us shakhs ko dekha hai jis ne apni khwaahishaat hi ko apna khuda bana liya hai? Kya aap us ki bhi zimmedaari lene ke liye tayyaar hain
Kya aap ka khayaal yeh hai ke un ki aksariyat kuch sunti aur samajhti hai? Hargiz nahin, yeh sab jaanwaron jaise hain, balke un se bhi kuch zyaada hi gum-karda-raah hain
Kya aap ne nahin dekha ke aap ke Parwardigar ne kis tarah saaye ko phaila diya hai, aur woh chaahta to ek hi jagah saakin bana deta, phir hum ne aaftaab ko us ki daleel bana diya hai
Phir hum ne thoda thoda kar ke use apni taraf kheench liya hai
Aur wahi woh Khuda hai jis ne raat ko tumhaara parda aur neend ko tumhaari raahat aur din ko tumhaare uth khade hone ka waqt qaraar diya hai
Aur wahi woh hai jis ne hawaaon ko rehmat ki bashaarat ke liye rawaan kar diya hai, aur hum ne aasmaan se paak o paakeeza paani barsaaya hai
Taake us ke zariye murda shehar ko zinda banaayein, aur apni makhlooqaat mein se jaanwaron aur insaanon ki ek badi ta'daad ko seeraab karein
Aur hum ne un ke darmiyaan paani ko tarah tarah se taqseem kiya hai taake yeh log naseehat haasil karein, lekin insaanon ki aksariyat ne naashukri ke ilaawa har baat se inkaar kar diya hai
Aur hum chaahte to har qarya mein ek daraane waala bhej dete
Lihaaza aap kaafiron ke kehne mein na aayein aur un se aakhir dam tak jihaad karte rahein
Aur wahi Khuda hai jis ne dono daryaaon ko jaari kiya hai, is ka paani mazedaar aur meetha hai aur yeh namkeen aur kadwa hai, aur dono ke darmiyaan hadd-e-faasil aur mazboot rukaawat bana di hai
Aur wahi woh hai jis ne paani se insaan ko paida kiya hai aur phir us ko khaandaan aur susraal waala bana diya hai, aur aap ka Parwardigar bahut zyaada qudrat waala hai
Aur yeh log Parwardigar ko chhod kar aison ki ibaadat karte hain jo na faaida pahuncha sakte hain aur na nuqsaan, aur kaafir to hamesha Parwardigar ke khilaaf hi pusht-panaahi karta hai
Aur hum ne aap ko sirf bashaarat dene waala aur daraane waala bana kar bheja hai
Aap keh dijiye ke main tum logon se koi ajr nahin chaahta, magar yeh ke jo chaahe woh apne Parwardigar ka raasta ikhtiyaar kare
Aur aap us Khuda-e-Hayy o Qayyoom par e'timaad karein jise maut aane waali nahin hai, aur usi ki hamd ki tasbeeh karte rahein, ke woh apne bandon ke gunaahon ki ittilaa ke liye khud hi kaafi hai

Us ne aasmaan o zameen aur us ke darmiyaan ki makhlooqaat ko chhe dinon ke andar paida kiya hai, aur us ke baad Arsh par apna iqtidaar qaaim kiya hai. Woh Rehmaan hai, us ki takhleeq ke baare mein usi baakhabar se daryaaft karo

Aur jab un se kaha jaata hai ke Rehmaan ko sajda karo to kehte hain ke yeh Rehmaan kya hai? Kya hum use sajda kar lein jis ke baare mein tum hukm de rahe ho? Aur is tarah un ki nafrat mein aur izaafa ho jaata hai
Ba-barakat hai woh zaat jis ne aasmaan mein burj banaaye hain aur us mein chiraagh aur chamakta hua chaand qaraar diya hai
Aur wahi woh hai jis ne raat aur din mein ek ko doosre ka jaanasheen banaaya hai, us insaan ke liye jo ibrat haasil karna chaahe ya shukr-e-Parwardigar ada karna chaahe
Aur Allah ke bande wahi hain jo zameen par aahista chalte hain, aur jab jaahil un se khitaab karte hain to salaamati ka paighaam de dete hain
Yeh log raaton ko is tarah guzaarte hain ke apne Rab ki baargaah mein kabhi sar-ba-sujood rehte hain aur kabhi haalat-e-qiyaam mein rehte hain
Aur yeh kehte hain ke Parwardigar! Hum se azaab-e-Jahannam ko pher de, ke us ka azaab bahut sakht aur paaedaar hai
Woh badtareen manzil aur mahal-e-iqaamat hai
Aur yeh log jab kharch karte hain to na israaf karte hain aur na kanjoosi se kaam lete hain, balke un dono ke darmiyaan ausat darje ka raasta ikhtiyaar karte hain

Aur woh log Khuda ke saath kisi aur khuda ko nahin pukaarte hain, aur kisi bhi nafs ko agar Khuda ne mohtaram qaraar de diya hai to use haq ke baghair qatl nahin karte, aur zina bhi nahin karte hain, ke jo aisa amal karega woh apne amal ki saza bhi bardaasht karega
Jise roz-e-qiyaamat dugna kar diya jaaega aur woh usi mein zillat ke saath hamesha hamesha pada rahega

Ilaawa us shakhs ke jo tauba kar le aur imaan le aaye aur nek amal bhi kare, ke Parwardigar us ki buraaiyon ko achchhaaiyon se tabdeel kar dega, aur Khuda bahut zyaada bakhshne waala aur meharbaan hai
Aur jo tauba kar lega aur amal-e-saaleh anjaam dega woh Allah ki taraf waaqai rujoo karne waala hai
Aur woh log jhooth aur fareb ke paas haazir bhi nahin hote hain, aur jab laghw kaamon ke qareeb se guzarte hain to buzurgaana andaaz se guzar jaate hain
Aur un logon ko jab aayaat-e-Ilaahiya ki yaad dilaayi jaati hai to behre aur andhe ho kar gir nahin padte hain
Aur woh log baraabar dua karte rehte hain ke Khudaaya! Humein hamaari azwaaj aur aulaad ki taraf se khunaki-e-chashm ata farma, aur humein saahibaan-e-taqwa ka peshwa bana de
Yahi woh log hain jinhein un ke sabr ki bina par Jannat ke baala-khaane ata kiye jaayenge, aur wahaan unhein ta'zeem aur salaam ki pesh-kash ki jaaegi
Woh unhi maqaamaat par hamesha hamesha rahenge, ke woh behtareen mustaqar aur haseen-tareen mahal-e-iqaamat hai
Paighambar! Aap keh dijiye ke agar tumhaari duaayein na hotin to Parwardigar tumhaari parwa bhi na karta. Tum ne us ke Rasool ki takzeeb ki hai, to anqareeb us ka azaab bhi bardaasht karna padega
